title: Front Desk / Customer Service Officer Job at R & R Recruiting Services
content:
R & R Recruiting Services is a Recruitment Agency, Training, Consulting & Human Resources Management.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Front Desk / Customer Service Officer
Job Location: Okota, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours:


	Monday – Saturday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM
	Sunday: 12:00 PM – 6:00 PM (shift basis; anyone who works on Sunday will not resume on Monday)


Job Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Welcome visitors and attend to customers professionally.
	Handle customer enquiries and complaints.
	Answer calls and manage front desk activities.
	Maintain records and ensure a tidy reception area.
	Provide general administrative support when needed.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Minimum of SSCE / OND.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Must be polite, organised, and customer-focused.
	Previous front desk or customer service experience is an advantage.


Remuneration


	Salary: N70,000 – N80,000 monthly.
	Performance Bonus: Available.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email

Note: For inquiries, send a WhatsApp message to: 09035411252.

  "title": "Outlet Concept Manager - Electronics",
  "description": "Ascentech Services Limited is a full-fledged Human Resource Solution Provider incorporated in 2013 with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We are committed to forging long-term partnerships with our clients by creating and delivering robust and flexible services that address the changing needs of their business.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Outlet Concept Manager - Electronics

Job Location: Lagos - As Assigned
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced Electronics Retail Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations and commercial performance of the electronics category within a retail outlet.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving sales and margins, managing staff, controlling inventory, ensuring proper merchandising, and delivering excellent customer service.


Key Responsibilities


	Drive sales and revenue growth for the electronics category and achieve assigned sales targets.
	Monitor category margins and ensure compliance with approved commercial targets.
	Lead, supervise, train, and motivate the electronics sales team.
	Monitor staff performance, provide constructive feedback, and manage manpower effectively.
	Ensure proper stock management and maintain accuracy between system/book stock and physical inventory.
	Monitor stock losses, shrinkage, damages, returns, and inventory discrepancies.
	Ensure proper execution of promotional activities, product displays, shelf cards, signage, and in-store marketing materials.
	Ensure retail selling prices are accurately updated and properly displayed.
	Maintain proper documentation of goods received, transfers, returns, gate passes, and other retail transactions.
	Monitor product availability and ensure timely replenishment of fast-moving items.
	Coordinate sales returns, refunds, and product/service-centre issues.
	Monitor customer complaints and ensure timely resolution of after-sales service issues.
	Ensure adherence to retail operating standards, company policies, and merchandising guidelines.
	Prepare and submit relevant sales, inventory, and operational reports.
	Ensure a positive customer shopping experience and maintain high standards of service.
	Perform other duties related to retail operations as assigned.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Retail Management, or a related field.
	3&ndash;5 years of relevant experience in electronics retail, consumer electronics, home appliances, or a similar retail environment.
	Proven experience managing a retail store, electronics department
	Demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets and manage category performance.
	Experience in team supervision, inventory control, merchandising, and customer service.
	Good understanding of retail operations, sales processes, and stock management.
	Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
	Good commercial awareness and customer-service orientation.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to prepare basic sales and inventory reports.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced retail environment.


Ideal candidate:


	The ideal candidate should have a strong background in electronics / consumer electronics retail, with experience managing sales, staff, inventory, merchandising, and customer service.


Salary
N300,000 &ndash; N700,000 gross per month.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: cv@ascentech.com.ng using &quot;ELECTRONICS 17&quot; as the subject of the email.",
